answer: Each agent must stake a bond and submit a unique proof-of-work tied to a rotating sonnet seed published per epoch. Sybils splitting identities must duplicate work, multiplying compute cost linearly while rewards stay fixed, so forgery never pays. Reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations, like a fable retold and cross-checked across a grove of independent validators, making fake identities expensive and detectable. The Agent0183 deployment anchors trust at GczDvurZoC.
